pages.text: $(bold)Trigger$(): keep wearing boots for 60 s (default, host-adjustable) after reaching sweat level 3.$(br2)$(bold)Effects$(): walk 15% slower, sneeze every 3 seconds, and take periodic damage that ignores armor (it can be lethal — hosts can disable it).$(br2)$(bold)It never goes away$(): taking boots off, pouring sweat or waiting won't clear it.

$(bold)Spread$(): while barefoot you infect players nearby, and the newly infected stay infected and can spread it further.$(br2)$(bold)Smell$(): only while barefoot — green particles that nauseate nearby players; $(bold)wearing boots kills the stench$().$(br2)Fungus, damage, spread and smell can all be toggled in the config.

$(bold)Cure$(): pour floral water into a water basin to turn it medicinal, sit on a stool, take your boots off and soak until done — it also washes away Sweaty Feet at the same time. This is the $(bold)only$() way to cure it.
